records.rule: Preserve researched algorithms and lessons, but redesign their objects, shifts, masks, state and execution contracts as project-owned ooRexx semantics.
There is no universal best enhancement method; retain materially different methods/settings as parallel derived views and compare stable evidence across them.
Media stream, channel, input material, acoustic source hypothesis and transcript layer are distinct. Never silently downmix.
Do not mutate source evidence. Describe transformations and produce derived material with lineage.
Agreement between methods/models is corroboration, not proof of accuracy.
ForeignBuffer/ForeignTensor/Python/native handles are transient runtime capabilities, never canonical evidence.
State zero-copy claims per boundary; do not promote a local shared-storage fact into a whole-pipeline claim.
Streaming state belongs to sessions/providers with explicit history, EOS, flush, checkpoint and affinity semantics.
Precision and quantization are explicit execution policy. Protect semantic roles that must not silently lose precision.
Audio derives requirements; Job-to-Node Allocation determines eligibility/ranking/lease; provider executes; results return as material plus evidence.
Speech presence/segmentation is an assessment layer before lexical transcription; low-SNR fluent ASR output is not automatically credible.
Scene alignment is an assessed projection over immutable recording timelines, not a timestamp rewrite.
Audio derives placement requirements and value-only dispatch envelopes; the Job-to-Node allocator owns hard eligibility, ranking and placement leases. Audio must not rank or lease nodes.
